title: Palm Springs
tagline: Same wedding. Same day. Different snacks.
about: Two strangers get stuck reliving the same wedding day in Palm Springs over and over.

    StartersPool float pizza bitesMini pepperoni and mozzarella pizzas baked crisp, oregano on topHow to make it500g pizza dough150ml pizza sauce250g mozzarella, grated150g pepperoni, sliced1 tsp dried oreganoRoll the dough thin and cut into small rounds.Top each with sauce, mozzarella, a slice of pepperoni and a pinch of oregano.Bake at 220°C until crisp and bubbling.Desert bar jalapeño poppersJalapeño halves stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in baconHow to make it12 large jalapeno chillies200g cream cheese80g cheddar, grated12 rashers of streaky bacon, halvedHalve the jalapenos lengthways and scrape out the seeds.Mix the cream cheese with the cheddar and fill each half.Wrap each half with half a rasher of bacon.Bake at 200°C until the bacon is crisp.Desert wedding tuna tostadasThe wedding reception in the desert, the same one every dayHow to make itAs written, serves 4Mini tostadas topped with raw tuna dressed in lime, soy and sesame, smashed avocado, pickled jalapeño and a squeeze of chipotle mayo.Cut 8 small corn tortillas into rounds with a 7cm cutter, brush with oil and bake at 200°C for 8 minutes until crisp.Dice 250g sashimi-grade tuna and toss with 1 tbsp soy, the juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp sesame oil and sliced spring onion.Mash 1 avocado with salt and lime.Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo.Top each tostada with avocado, tuna, a slice of pickled jalapeño and a dot of mayo.Queso fundido with chorizoNyles has had it a thousand times. Still good.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsTala and Abe's wedding fish tacosSpiced pan-fried white fish, lime crema, pickled red onion, cabbageHow to make it600g white fish fillets1 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp salt2 tbsp vegetable oil1 red onion3 limes150ml sour cream1/4 small cabbage12 corn tortillasQuickly pickle the sliced red onion in some of the lime juice.Mix the sour cream with lime juice for a crema and shred the cabbage.Dust the fish with chilli, cumin and salt and pan fry in the vegetable oil until just cooked.Warm the tortillas and fill with cabbage, fish, crema and pickled onion.Reception chicken with spinach and ricottaThe wedding dinner Nyles has eaten more times than he can countHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach, ricotta and lemon, roasted golden, with a lemon caper butter sauce and crushed baby potatoes.Heat the oven to 200°C.Boil 800g baby potatoes 15 minutes.Mix 150g ricotta, 60g wilted chopped spinach, 30g parmesan and lemon zest.Cut a deep pocket in 4 chicken breasts and fill.Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast 18 minutes.Crush the potatoes with butter and salt.In the pan, melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon and 1 tbsp capers and spoon over the chicken.SweetsWedding cake againButter cake layers, lemon curd, whipped cream, white icingHow to make it250g butter, softened250g caster sugar4 eggs250g self-raising flour200g lemon curd300ml thickened cream250g icing sugar1 tbsp milkBeat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour. Divide between 2 tins.Bake at 175°C until golden and springy.Cool completely.Whip the cream and fill the cakes with lemon curd and cream.Ice white with icing sugar mixed with milk.DrinksRoy's crossbow micheladaMexican lager, lime and tomato juice, hot sauce, chilli salt rimHow to make it2 tbsp salt1 tsp chilli powder4 limes240ml tomato juicehot sauce, 16 dashes1 tsp Worcestershire sauce4 bottles of Mexican style lager (330 ml each)2 cups iceMix the salt with the chilli powder on a plate.Rub the rims of 4 tall glasses with lime and dip into the salt. Fill with ice.Into each glass add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire.Top slowly with cold lager, stir gently and add a lime wedge.
